entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The State of Jharkhand
2. Rubi Kumari, wife of Sudip Kumar, daughter of Raj Kumar Paswan, resident of Sector 5 Pnt
Colony, Q. No. 13/2, Po & Ps- Sector 6, District- Bokaro .... ...

Opposite Parties Coram: Hon'Ble
Mr. Justice Rajesh Shankar

For the Petitioner : Mr. Baibhaw Gahlaut, Advocate For the
State : Mr. Shashi Kumar Verma, A.P.P. Order No. 09 Dated: 09.09.2024 The petitioner
apprehending his arrest for the offences punishable under Sections 498A/420/323/504/34 of the
Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act in connection with Sector Vi P.S.
Case No. 64 of 2021 pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Bokaro, has prayed for
grant of anticipatory bail.
2.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case and has not committed any offence as alleged in the F.I.R.
The petitioner is the husband of the opposite party no. 2.
It is further submitted that the petitioner has neither made any demand of dowry nor has tortured the opposite party no.2 for non-fulfilment of the same.
The allegation made against the petitioner in the present F.I.R. is completely concocted.

Hence, he may be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
3.
No one appears on behalf of the opposite party no. 2 despite valid service of notice upon her.
4. Learned A.P.P. opposes the petitioner's prayer for anticipatory bail.

5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering that it is a case under Sections 498A/420/323/504/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and there is no requirement of custodial trial of the petitioner, without expressing any view on the merit of the present case, he is directed to appear and seek regular bail before the concerned Trial Court within three weeks, which shall be disposed of by the said court in strict compliance of the guidelines laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr. reported in 2021 (10) SCC 773 as well as the observation made in the Sudip Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand on 9 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52627867/
1 case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra) reported in 2023-LiveLaw (SC) 233.
6.
